Embedding Loss Playground

Pick a dataset and a sentence-transformers loss, press Train, and watch a small embedding model fine-tune live in your browser. Every loss's forward pass and gradient is implemented exactly, so what you see is how that loss really behaves.

Read the blog post Source on GitHub
A 32-dimensional bag-of-words model trained with Adam. Absolute numbers won't match a real transformer; the way each loss behaves does. MIT licensed.
